observations.finding: All five named data APIs delivered as Data/readOnly=true, both successful and DryRunOperationException calls, with explicit responseElements:null. This includes PutRecord and PutRecords despite their write semantics.
observations.auditMismatch: auditProjection sets PutRecord/PutRecords readOnly=false; retain Data category and null response, change measured readOnly projection.

observations.finding: PutRecord/PutRecords successful requests log only resolved streamARN. Dry runs additionally retain dryRun:true. Data, PartitionKey, ExplicitHashKey and the entire Records array are absent, not replaced with sentinels. StreamName input on PutRecords and dry PutRecord becomes streamARN in requestParameters.
observations.auditMismatch: auditRequest omits Data/Records.Data only, leaving partition/hash keys and batch metadata, and does not supply operation-specific resolved-ARN-only projection.

observations.finding: GetRecords retains the exact supplied shardIterator and limit, plus supplied streamARN; iterator is not redacted. GetShardIterator retains shardId/shardIteratorType and the supplied stream selector. SubscribeToShard retains consumerARN, shardId, lower-camel startingPosition.type and dryRun when supplied. Subscription audit response remains null, not a captured event frame.

Native StreamName resource projection is anomalous and retained literally: ARN arn:aws:kinesis:us-east-1:<streamName>:stream/null, no accountId. PutRecords(success), PutRecord(dry), GetShardIterator(dry) also include a second canonical stream resource with accountId. Name-based DescribeStream and AddTagsToStream have only the anomalous entry. ARN-based calls have canonical resources.
observations.auditMismatch: recordCall emits exactly one normalized resource with accountId for every call, so array cardinality/field presence/ARN text differ. Keep audit display projection separate from authorization/resource lookup; do not normalize these raw observations or change engine resource identity.

observations.finding: DescribeStreamConsumer by ConsumerARN logs the exact incarnation ARN; by StreamARN+ConsumerName logs versionless <streamARN>/consumer/<name>, despite API result containing the full incarnation. Both are readOnly Management with null response and empty LookupEvents Resources.
observations.auditMismatch: auditResource uses typed result incarnation for name-based description, and recordCall populates a lookup alias for both; measured versionless detail resource and empty lookup aliases differ.

observations.finding: RegisterStreamConsumer logs parent stream resource, non-null consumer response, and three LookupEvents aliases: parent stream ARN, consumer name, full consumer incarnation ARN. consumerCreationTimestamp is native formatted text, not epoch seconds. Parent/resource/response behavior independently observed in previousSetup S3 and current LookupEvents.
observations.auditMismatch: auditResource substitutes returned consumer resource; response is always null; one consumer-ARN lookup alias loses parent/name aliases.

observations.finding: LookupEvents Resources is empty for exact correlated DescribeStream, DescribeStreamConsumer (both input forms), ListShards, ListStreamConsumers, ListTagsForStream. CreateStream and AddTagsToStream have stream-name aliases. Four ResourceName lookups independently recover CreateStream/AddTags by name and RegisterStreamConsumer by parent ARN, consumer ARN or consumer name.
observations.auditMismatch: Current special case empties only ListShards and uses an ARN alias for all other resource-bound calls. Introduce measured per-operation lookup alias projection rather than deriving aliases from CloudTrail detail resources.

observations.finding: Selectors were read back before calls; CloudTrail reordered FieldSelectors without changing semantics. Trail status remained IsLogging:true and final status records LatestDeliveryAttemptSucceeded 2026-09-19T10:35:54Z with no LatestDeliveryError. Initial five-minute-set data became visible at 10:36:16Z. A second five-operation success/dry set ran after fifteen minutes before early termination.

boundedOmissions: Final run stopped after all five initial-set successes and dry-run contrasts were delivered and a second settled set was executed; second-set delivery was not awaited and no absence claim is made.
No IAM-denied call was introduced: useful DryRun contrasts were captured without changing any shared identity or policy.

No S3 delivery observation for CreateStream or RegisterStreamConsumer in the final run; exact-ID management history recovered both, and earlier owned attempt delivered RegisterStreamConsumer through S3.
Only sampled selectors/operations/input forms are established. Resource cardinality, aliases and null response conclusions do not generalize to every management operation or error.

Three retained final-run S3 records were AWS Internal activity on the owned stream, not calls emitted by this probe; matchedCallLabel is null and they are not used as direct-call conformance evidence.

First setup was cleaned before start-logging because a probe comparison treated AWS selector-field reordering as unequal. Second attempt was cleaned after the first settled set because the probe JSON decoder rejected AddTagsToStream empty successful body; its TransportException is a probe-decoding failure, not an AWS service error. Both attempts remain under previousSetup with actual cleanup proofs.

minimalIntegrationRecommendation: Keep changes in the Kinesis audit projection; do not change Kinesis write/read behavior or authorization identities based on audit display quirks.
For PutRecord/PutRecords, project readOnly=true and an operation-specific request containing resolved streamARN and optional dryRun only; keep null responses for all five data calls.

Project RegisterStreamConsumer consumer response (native timestamp string), parent-stream detail resource, and three measured lookup aliases. Project name-based DescribeStreamConsumer to versionless consumer detail ARN and no lookup aliases.

Replace the single-resource/single-alias shortcut with operation/input-aware detail-resource arrays and independent LookupEvents aliases for sampled operations. Preserve native missing accountId and extra legacy name-derived resources if matching these measured native records; do not route malformed display ARNs into resource resolution.

Use this exact-request-correlated fixture to cover redaction, readOnly, parent-vs-consumer, versionless consumer, empty lookup aliases and multi-resource boundaries. Do not infer unsampled operation behavior.
